issues.description: Attribute naming inconsistency: the problem statement's task list (problem_statement.md lines 16-18) refers to attributes named 'inscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents', while the UML diagram in the same problem statement (problem_statement.md lines 63-69) and the reference implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java lines 6-10) use the longer names 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents'. This mismatch can confuse students about the exact field names to implement and the expected constructor parameter order.
issues.suggestedFix: Make attribute names consistent across the exercise. Either update the problem statement text to use 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents' (to match the UML and solution) and explicitly state the constructor parameter order, or change the UML/solution/template to accept the shorter names and document that mapping. Ensure the constructor parameter order in the problem text matches the UML and code.
